messages:
mira: Quick thread: RFC follow-up on preflight gating. I think we need an "adversarial probe" bundle that runs before heavy evals. Purpose: catch tokenization, BOS/EOF misalignments, and kv-cache edgecases.
vincent: +1. Too many models pass basic loads but fail on real-world prompts. Adversarial probes should be tiny and fast.
raj: What do we include? my draft: (1) tokenizer roundtrip (2) prefix+continuation replay that exercises kv eviction (3) softmax tail-check to catch logits collapse.
elaine: Add a header mismatch probe: swapped byte-order or unexpected model metadata can cause runtime to fallback silently. cheap checksum compare on model bytes.
mira: Love it. Example probe harness we ran internally:
```json
{"probes": ["tok-rt", "kv-replay-32", "logit-topk-shift"], "max_runtime_ms": 300000}
```
vincent: How do we fail the pipeline? soft-fail vs hard-fail? Some probes are flaky depending on hardware/quantization.
raj: Propose tiers: FAIL-HALT (load/abi mismatch), FAIL-RETRY (quantization parity spikes), WARN (nonblocking degen). Circuit-breaker config maps probe -> severity.
elaine: Also need artifact provenance: every probe run should emit an immutable bundle: model-sha, runtime-shim-sha, probe-id, stdout, numeric signature. We'll store as registry artifact with signed metadata.
mira: Numeric signature = deterministic vector of checksums (tokenization hash + topk logits md5) so we can diff between runs quickly.
vincent: Operational question: run adversarial probes on CPU or cheap dev-GPU? Running on CPU catches many loading/format issues faster, but kv behavior differs on GPU.
raj: Hybrid: run tokenizer/hash on CPU immediately; schedule kv-replay on cheapest available GPU with a low-slot priority. That keeps feedback fast (<10min) while preserving signal.
elaine: For the microbench stage, let's standardize three sampling profiles: tiny (seq=64, 100 samples), short (seq=128, 500 samples), long (seq=512, 200 samples). Microbench uses short by default.
mira: We should capture the request-level headers used in production (prompt templates, stop-tokens) so bench comparators don't drift. Add a field bench_profile.request_template to the artifact.
vincent: Can we unify the compat assertions with existing runtime ABI checks? Duplicate work is painful. Maybe a small shim adapter that the runtime team exposes: /health/compat?model_id=xxx -> returns compat bundle.
raj: If runtime can sign the compat result, we can avoid re-running the same checks downstream. But ensure signature includes the shimmed binary hash.
elaine: Action items: mira -> draft probe list + severity map; vincent -> infra cost estimate for hybrid probe runs; raj -> compat artifact schema and signing spec. I'll schedule a 20m sync. cicero-bot: queued adversarial probe job for model "mnk-lite-3" at 2026-06-01T09:02:00Z. Results will be appended.
mira: one more ask: add a flag to opt-out for internal dev models so we don't spam infra during heavy intake batches.
